title: My friends and I built a co-op deckbuilder with AI. It hits Steam this Wednesday.
author: beelllllll
selftext:
I’ve started and stopped making games more times than I can count. Then Claude 4.6 came out, and it helped me finally get past the roadblocks and build a game with my friends that we’re actually releasing.

It’s called **For The Realm**, a co-op tactical deckbuilder where you and your friends fight to save a fantasy world on the brink of collapse. Build your decks, set up combos with your party, and battle your way through dangerous encounters. Having strong cards is one thing, figuring out how to make them work together is where the fun begins. 

Going through the whole process, from an idea to something other people can actually play, has been incredibly rewarding. Especially getting to do it with friends.

I genuinely think we’re heading into a gaming renaissance. So many people have game ideas they’ve never been able to bring to life, and that’s starting to change. It did for me.

Steam page:  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/3040260/For\_The\_Realm/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3040260/For_The_Realm/) 

**We launch in Early Access this Wednesday, October 7!** Thanks for checking it out, a wishlist would mean a lot.
